items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And my first job was with him

ctx.x: Well, when you came back to New York, what was your first job?

It was with Scott...I forget his first name. He had one leg...Oh what's his name, Scott. Isn't that a shame I don't remember his name. He was a tenor player, clarinet player. And my first job was with him and I'll never forget John Hardy and he were friends and John Hardy came by and played and he was still in his army uniform and that's when I first met John Hardy from Texas, a very fine tenor player. And then, let's see, of course I was jammin', 'cause I had to wait out the six-month period, before you could…
